description: This file declares functions, classes, and enums related to the EmbeddingBag operation in the ATen native library of PyTorch, including kernel cache structures and utility functions for embedding bag computations.

classes.name: _CallbackAndBlockSize
classes.description: Template struct for callback and block size management in embedding bag kernel cache.

classes.name: _EmbeddingBagKernelCacheImpl
classes.description: Template struct combining multiple storage mixins for caching embedding bag kernels.

classes.description: Type alias for a specific instantiation of _EmbeddingBagKernelCacheImpl with predefined storage mixins.
